legend.0: Noise: tiny n or |r|<0.1 or perm_p>0.5
legend.3: Moderate: perm_p<0.05 but fails Bonferroni or sign unstable across windows
legend.4: Strong: perm_p<0.05, passes Bonferroni, plausible lag, n>100
legend.5: Robust: strong plus consistent sign in pre-war and war windows and event study agrees

legend.0: Trivial or tautological (same domain, obvious mechanics)
legend.2: Somewhat interesting cross-domain link with small effect
legend.3: Interesting: clear cross-domain effect or a clean pre/post-war regime change
legend.4: Very interesting: sizeable effect a desk would want to investigate

legend.0: Entirely expected (or a null control that stayed null)
legend.3: Surprising: sign or timing differs from intuition
legend.4: Very surprising: robust cross-domain link with no obvious mechanism
legend.5: Shocking: contradicts the hypothesis and intuition with strong statistics
